author: granite state times
title: Utility work to cause closures and detours at several Nashua locations in late April
text:
The City of Nashua announced on Apr. 22 that multiple utility projects will take place at various locations, resulting in street and lane closures between Apr. 22 and Apr. 29.
These projects are expected to affect traffic patterns for drivers and pedestrians across the city as crews carry out essential maintenance and infrastructure improvements.
On Norton Street, between Lock Street and Summer Street, a full street closure is scheduled for Tuesday, Apr. 28 from 7:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., as workers replace utility poles. On Franklin Street, from Main Street to Front Street, a lane closure will occur Monday, Apr. 27 from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m., while water service installation is underway.
Concord Street, between Thorton Avenue and Hills Ferry Road, will see lane, shoulder, and sidewalk closures on Wednesday and Thursday (Apr. 22–23) from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m., due to milling and paving work related to water and sewer services.
Additionally, Manchester Street northbound will be detoured between Charlotte Avenue and Hills Ferry Road from Monday through Wednesday (Apr. 27–29), with lane closures each day from 8 a.m. to 4 p.m., as paving operations proceed.
Residents are advised by the city government that these temporary changes may impact travel times in affected areas during the scheduled periods.
